DHAKA, June 8 (Reuter) - Cautious pre-budget trading will continue when the Dhaka stock market reopens after the weekend, brokers said. "The investors may remain cautious ahead of the announcement of the new budget," said broker Khurshid Alam. Brokers said investors preferred to watch the market until the new budget, which is due to be announced on June 12. The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) benchmark index closed 3.21 points or 0.28 percent down at 1,141.84 on a turnover of 67.1 million taka on Thursday. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
